q: How do I calculate the carbon footprint of vinyl flooring?
title: Vinyl flooring carbon footprint per sq m
short: Weigh the PVC, plasticiser or stone filler, wear layer and print film per square metre and multiply by supplier figures. Add calendering or extrusion, lamination and cutting energy, then divide the plant's energy by square metres made.

ul: Plasticiser, stone powder or chalk filler.
Print film, wear layer and coating.
Calendering or extrusion of the core.
Laminating the print film and wear layer.

p: Report per square metre by thickness and type. A rigid SPC plank carries more filler and weight than a thin sheet.

example.title: Worked example: plant energy per sq m (one month)
lines: Plant total: 106,500 / 200,000 = 0.532 kg CO2 per sq m
Add PVC, filler and films for the full figure
example.note: Inputs are illustrative; use your own bills and production records.

senseible: Senseible reads the plant's electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and fuel invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record, the plant-level input to a per-unit figure. Bought-in materials go to the supplier evidence trail; product reports are self-declared drafts.
